sloka: जयः च विप्लुलः प्राप्तो मृत्युः च प्रतिषेधितः ।सुयुद्धेन च ते सर्वे लोकास् तत्र सुतोषिताः ॥६-७-१५॥।।
transliteration: jayaḥ ca viplulaḥ prāpto mṛtyuḥ ca pratiṣedhitaḥ ।suyuddhena ca te sarve lokās tatra sutoṣitāḥ ॥6-7-15॥।।

translations.english: "Oh King Plunging into the ocean, which was in the shape of Yama's realm, with an enormous alligator in the form of rod of death, adorned with Salmali trees, turbulent with a huge wave in the form of Death 's noose, infested with Lord of Death's attendants as serpents, unassailable on account of the mighty Jwara (spirit of fever), you have obtained a great victory over the Lord of Death 's great army and the army was warded off. By your good battle all the people (of the world) were delighted.
